name: fs_v1_wide
_doc: Wider capacity variant for later capacity/fuel comparisons (NOT the default; measured fuel in agents/B/REPORT.md). Capacities only; observation dims come from bot/src/nn_schema.h (agent C), head F/contexts/R from schemas/heads/<name>.json (D/E/F). See agents/B/REPORT.md.

fallback._note: Used only while agent C's nn_schema.h does not exist. Models built on it carry obs_schema_hash 0 and are rejected (schema_mismatch) against any real schema.
